jobs.title: AVP Dealer Transformation
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Shape the Future of Wealth Management

Sun Life is seeking an experienced and forward-thinking AVP, Dealer Transformation
to lead the evolution of our Retail Wealth Platform and transformation strategy. This executive role will define and execute a multi-year roadmap that enhances advisor and client experiences, accelerates digital innovation, improves operational efficiency, and supports the future growth of our wealth business.

As a key member of the Dealer Leadership Team, you will serve as a business platform owner, partnering across Distribution, Operations, Technology, Compliance, Risk, and Product teams to deliver meaningful business outcomes and position Sun Life for the future of wealth management.

What Will you do?

Develop and execute the Retail Wealth Platform strategy and transformation roadmap.
Lead enterprise-wide initiatives that modernize advisor and client experiences.
Drive digital, data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities across the dealer.
Identify and implement opportunities to simplify processes, improve scalability, and increase operational efficiency.
Partner with business leaders to build capabilities that support advisor growth and business expansion.
Provide strategic leadership on technology modernization and platform evolution.
Translate regulatory and industry changes into practical business solutions.
Influence and align senior stakeholders to successfully deliver complex transformation initiatives.

What do you need to succeed?

Senior leadership experience in wealth management, financial services, consulting, or business transformation.
Strong understanding of the Canadian wealth management and advisor ecosystem.
Proven track record leading large-scale business transformation initiatives.
Experience developing strategic roadmaps and delivering measurable business outcomes.
Expertise in digital transformation, automation, data, AI, and platform modernization.
Strong business and financial acumen with experience building business cases and assessing investment opportunities.
Knowledge of Canadian securities regulations and dealer operations.
Exceptional executive communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join Sun Life?

This is a unique opportunity to lead one of the most significant transformation mandates within Sun Life Wealth, helping shape the future advisor and client experience while driving growth, innovation, and operational excellence across the business.

If you're a strategic transformation leader who thrives on building the future, we'd love to hear from you.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Salary Range:

155,000/155 000 - 225,000/225 000

Job Category:

Sales - Distribution Support

15/10/2026

jobs.title: Workforce Strategy & Talent Development Director (HRBP)
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

Workforce Strategy & Talent Development Director (HRBP)

Your Impact

Shape the future of the organization through workforce, talent, and organizational strategy. As a Workforce Strategy & Talent Development Director, you’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, influencing critical business decisions, driving global workforce transformation, strengthening leadership capability, and delivering people strategies that accelerate business performance. You’ll lead workforce planning, organization design, talent strategy, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives while tackling complex challenges and delivering meaningful, measurable business impact.

This is an individual contributor role requiring five days per week onsite, offering the opportunity to work closely with senior leaders and colleagues across the organization.

What You Will Do

Partner with senior leaders to align people strategies with business priorities and organizational needs.
Lead global workforce planning, organization design, talent strategy, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
Provide executive coaching, consultation, and trusted counsel to leaders, influencing decisions and constructively challenging thinking when needed.
Drive organizational transformation and change initiatives from planning through execution.
Use workforce and talent analytics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Lead complex, cross-functional people initiatives with strong program and stakeholder management discipline.
Drive alignment and consistency on function-specific priorities and global HR programs across all regions.
Partner with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and HR Shared Services, to deliver integrated solutions and talent advisory to business leaders.

What Success Looks Like

Senior and executive leaders see you as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
Business strategy, workforce plans, and talent priorities are strongly aligned.
Leadership pipelines are strengthened and succession plans are robust and future-ready.
Organizational changes and transformation initiatives are delivered effectively and on schedule.
Complex people initiatives are managed with clear governance, milestones, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
Risks and dependencies are anticipated early, enabling faster, better-informed decisions.
Workforce and talent insights translate into recommendations that improve business performance and organizational effectiveness.
Strong collaboration and alignment across the HR team and broader organization.

What It Takes

Significant HR Business Partner experience supporting senior and executive leaders in complex, global organizations.
Expertise in workforce planning, talent management, succession planning, leadership development, and organizational design.
Strong business acumen, executive presence, and consulting capability.
Ability to coach, influence, and constructively challenge leaders.
Experience leading large-scale transformation, organizational change, and strategic initiatives.
Strong project and program management skills, including planning, prioritization, stakeholder management, governance, and execution.
Ability to connect strategy to action and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Enterprise mindset with strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.

One Last Thing

If you’re ready to shape the workforce, develop talent, and help drive meaningful organizational changes, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and help shape the organization, the talent, and the future of the business.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: VP of Sales, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Job Title:
VP of Sales, Enterprise

Location:
Remote, Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Travel:
Approximately 30-40%

Employment Type:
Permanent, Full-Time

Hiring Timeline:
Immediate

Reporting Line:
Chief Strategy Officer

Existing Vacancy:
Yes. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Application Deadline:
Open until filled. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Compensation:

Base Salary:
170,000K - 190,000K CAD

Target Variable Compensation:
100% of base

Target OTE:
340,000K - 380,000K CAD

Actual compensation will depend on experience, location, and role scope. Variable compensation is tied to sales performance under FIQ's applicable sales incentive plan.

About Fulfillment IQ

Fulfillment IQ (FIQ) is a supply chain technology and consulting company helping retailers, brands, and 3PLs solve complex fulfillment and logistics challenges.

Our work spans three core practices: Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery & Transformation, and Implementation. We help customers assess and design supply-chain strategies, select and implement technology, modernize fulfillment operations, and build technology solutions that solve complex operational challenges.

The Opportunity

FIQ is looking for an experienced VP of Sales, Enterprise to drive growth across our full portfolio of services.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying enterprise sales role for someone who knows how to sell complex professional services, not simply software licenses.

You will work with senior executives at large retailers, brands, 3PLs, and other supply-chain organizations to understand complex business and operational challenges, shape solutions with FIQ's consulting and technical teams, and own opportunities through commercial close.

As FIQ grows, you will also contribute to building the sales organization, including sales methodology, account strategy, forecasting, coaching, and future team development.

What You'll Do

Own complex enterprise opportunities from prospecting and qualification through discovery, solution development, proposal, negotiation, and close
Sell across FIQ's Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery & Transformation, and Implementation practices
Build relationships with C-suite and senior leaders across supply chain, logistics, operations, fulfillment, and technology
Diagnose customer challenges and translate them into multi-practice FIQ solutions
Build and maintain a strong enterprise pipeline through direct prospecting, industry relationships, referrals, partnerships, and FIQ-generated opportunities
Partner with Practice Leaders and subject-matter experts to develop compelling, commercially sound solutions
Develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities to expand FIQ's footprint across customer organizations
Maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM practices
Represent FIQ at customer meetings, industry conferences, partner events, and executive forums
Contribute to building FIQ's enterprise sales methodology, processes, and organization as the company scales

What We're Looking For

7+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience in supply chain/logistics, professional services, consulting, or enterprise technology
Deep understanding of fulfillment, warehousing, WMS/OMS/WES, 3PL operations, supply-chain technology, or logistics transformation is required
Demonstrated success selling complex professional services and consulting engagements, not solely software products
Experience selling solutions involving supply-chain technology delivery/transformation, implementation, and/or consulting
Proven ability to own long, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
Demonstrated experience closing high-value enterprise engagements
Strong executive presence and experience selling to C-suite and senior operational and technology leaders
Strong commercial judgment across scope, pricing, margin, negotiation, and contracting
Ability to work effectively with consultants, engineers, solution experts, and delivery leaders throughout the sales process
Strong pipeline-management and forecasting discipline
Prior experience helping build, scale, coach, or improve a sales organization is highly valued

Why Fulfillment IQ

You will have the opportunity to help grow our implementation business, develop important client relationships, and contribute to how we approach the market.

Work with experienced implementation leaders who understand the platforms and the operations they support.
Sell services that address practical warehouse challenges and make a visible difference to clients.
Have a voice in account priorities, partner relationships, and the development of the practice.
Work with colleagues who value direct communication, sound judgment, and accountability.

Health and Wellness

Comprehensive extended health and dental coverage for you and your family
Employee wellness programs where applicable

Time Off

Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays
Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

Retirement and Financial Security

CPP contributions and a group retirement savings plan with employer contributions
Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable

Professional Growth

Dedicated learning and development budget, with support for skills, leadership, and career progression

Flexible Work

Remote and hybrid work options, flexible hours aligned to role and client needs

Additional Perks

Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

Work Authorization

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

jobs.title: Director, PathWise Actuarial Implementation and AI-Enabled Process Transformation
jobs.description:
The Life Solutions division at Aon is seeking a Director to lead large-scale PathWise implementation projects. This role also supports AI-enabled process transformation initiatives for life and annuity insurers across North America. This client-facing role combines actuarial expertise, implementation leadership, and technology-enabled transformation to help insurers modernize modelling, reporting, workflow automation, AI-enabled systems, and operational workflows.

The Director will work within Aon Life Solutions, part of Aon’s Reinsurance Strategy and Technology Group to translate business needs into practical implementation plans, scalable operating models, and measurable delivery outcomes. This role will be based in Canada.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada. This role is not eligible for sponsorship, and we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa or work permit.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What The Day Will Look Like

Implementation and Client Delivery

Lead and support large-scale PathWise implementation projects for life and annuity insurers across North America.
Handle key implementation workstreams, including model migration, data integration, testing, reconciliation, workflow design, documentation, training, and production deployment.
Translate client business objectives and current-state processes into clear delivery plans, target-state solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
Develop and migrate actuarial models and production processes for valuation, pricing, financial reporting, capital, ALM, and risk management use cases.
Support delivery governance, issue resolution, risk management, collaborator communication, post-implementation stabilization, and client knowledge transfer.

AI-Enabled Process Transformation and Innovation

Identify, prioritize, and continuously refine opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled capabilities to improve actuarial modelling, reporting, reconciliation, documentation, and analysis processes across the PathWise lifecycle.
Collaborate closely with the PathWise AI and development teams to translate business difficulties into clear AI use cases, feature requests, and improvements.
Help clients redesign legacy actuarial workflows into more efficient, scalable, governed, and technology-enabled operating models.
Contribute to reusable implementation assets, process transformation playbooks, documentation templates, workflow designs, and AI-enabled delivery accelerators.
Lead or support pilots of new PathWise AI features, capturing user feedback and performance metrics, and consolidating insights into actionable recommendations for the PathWise AI roadmap
Promote responsible and controlled use of AI-enabled capabilities, including review, validation, traceability, documentation, and governance, and contribute to standard guidance on AI-enabled workflows

Business Development and Market Support

Support PathWise growth in the North American life and annuity market through client solutioning, demonstrations (including AI-enabled capabilities), proposals, implementation estimates, and project planning.
Partner with senior leaders in client discussions on actuarial modernization, implementation strategy, process automation, AI-enabled transformation, and business value.
Develop proof-of-concept materials and presentations on PathWise capabilities, implementation guidelines, and emerging insurance industry issues.
Develop and share case studies, training materials, and thought leadership that showcase successful AI-enabled PathWise use cases and evolving capabilities

How this opportunity is different

PathWise is Aon’s high-performance actuarial software platform, enabling insurers to model liabilities, assets, capital, and related business processes with speed, transparency, flexibility, and control. The platform supports modern actuarial modelling, scenario analysis, financial reporting, ALM, risk management, and enterprise-scale production processes.

In this role, you will help clients migrate models and processes into PathWise, improve actuarial production workflows, and apply automation and AI-enabled capabilities across requirements, model development, testing, reconciliation, documentation, workflow monitoring, and reporting. You will also help identify new AI applications within PathWise, develop improvements with the PathWise AI team, and promote adoption of emerging capabilities across client and internal teams.

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

10+ years of experience in life insurance, life reinsurance, actuarial consulting, financial technology, actuarial modelling, or enterprise platform implementation.
Experience with valuation, pricing, ALM, hedging, capital, financial reporting, risk management, model governance, or related actuarial functions.
Experience supporting or leading implementation, modernization, migration, or transformation projects within actuarial, finance, risk, or insurance technology environments.
Solid understanding of life and annuity products, reserves, capital, financial reporting, ALM, and risk management.
Practical experience with actuarial modelling platforms, model migration, data transformation, testing, reconciliation, workflow automation, documentation, and production process improvement.
Experience identifying and shaping AI-enabled transformation opportunities (e.g., automation, analytics, AI-assisted development, or generative AI applications) in actuarial or financial services processes, including working with development teams to refine and implement new features
Knowledge of programming, data workflows, Python, APIs, cloud infrastructure, or automation concepts is preferred.
Comfort acting as a bridge between actuarial users and technical AI / software teams, including providing structured feedback on prototypes and helping define success metrics and acceptance criteria for new capabilities
Strong project delivery, customer management, communication, and team leadership skills.
Member of the Society of Actuaries, Canadian Institute of Actuaries, or equivalent actuarial organization preferred.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate .

Job Title:
VP of Sales, Enterprise

Location:
Remote, Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Target Variable Compensation:
100% of base

Target OTE:
340,000K - 380,000K CAD

Actual compensation will depend on experience, location, and role scope. Variable compensation is tied to sales performance under FIQ's applicable sales incentive plan.

About Fulfillment IQ

Fulfillment IQ (FIQ) is a supply chain technology and consulting company helping retailers, brands, and 3PLs solve complex fulfillment and logistics challenges.

Our work spans three core practices: Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery & Transformation, and Implementation. We help customers assess and design supply-chain strategies, select and implement technology, modernize fulfillment operations, and build technology solutions that solve complex operational challenges.

The Opportunity

FIQ is looking for an experienced VP of Sales, Enterprise to drive growth across our full portfolio of services.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying enterprise sales role for someone who knows how to sell complex professional services, not simply software licenses.

You will work with senior executives at large retailers, brands, 3PLs, and other supply-chain organizations to understand complex business and operational challenges, shape solutions with FIQ's consulting and technical teams, and own opportunities through commercial close.

As FIQ grows, you will also contribute to building the sales organization, including sales methodology, account strategy, forecasting, coaching, and future team development.

What You'll Do

Own complex enterprise opportunities from prospecting and qualification through discovery, solution development, proposal, negotiation, and close
Sell across FIQ's Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery & Transformation, and Implementation practices
Build relationships with C-suite and senior leaders across supply chain, logistics, operations, fulfillment, and technology
Diagnose customer challenges and translate them into multi-practice FIQ solutions
Build and maintain a strong enterprise pipeline through direct prospecting, industry relationships, referrals, partnerships, and FIQ-generated opportunities
Partner with Practice Leaders and subject-matter experts to develop compelling, commercially sound solutions
Develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities to expand FIQ's footprint across customer organizations
Maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM practices
Represent FIQ at customer meetings, industry conferences, partner events, and executive forums
Contribute to building FIQ's enterprise sales methodology, processes, and organization as the company scales

What We're Looking For

7+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience in supply chain/logistics, professional services, consulting, or enterprise technology
Deep understanding of fulfillment, warehousing, WMS/OMS/WES, 3PL operations, supply-chain technology, or logistics transformation is required
Demonstrated success selling complex professional services and consulting engagements, not solely software products
Experience selling solutions involving supply-chain technology delivery/transformation, implementation, and/or consulting
Proven ability to own long, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles
Demonstrated experience closing high-value enterprise engagements
Strong executive presence and experience selling to C-suite and senior operational and technology leaders
Strong commercial judgment across scope, pricing, margin, negotiation, and contracting
Ability to work effectively with consultants, engineers, solution experts, and delivery leaders throughout the sales process
Strong pipeline-management and forecasting discipline
Prior experience helping build, scale, coach, or improve a sales organization is highly valued

Why Fulfillment IQ

You will have the opportunity to help grow our implementation business, develop important client relationships, and contribute to how we approach the market.

Work with experienced implementation leaders who understand the platforms and the operations they support.
Sell services that address practical warehouse challenges and make a visible difference to clients.
Have a voice in account priorities, partner relationships, and the development of the practice.
Work with colleagues who value direct communication, sound judgment, and accountability.

Comprehensive extended health and dental coverage for you and your family
Employee wellness programs where applicable

Flexible leave policies that respect local labour standards

Employee stock options (ESOP), where applicable
